'''Darth Ben'hade''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Imperial Guard]]sman in service to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[War on Iokath]]. In [[3630 BBY]] he accompanied the forces brought by [[Darth Acina|Empress Acina]] to [[Iokath]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Ben'hade appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a rare champion commander on Iokath, found only in the PVP instance.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
